user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point geometries from EPSG:4326 to the census tract layer CRS so the spatial join can use compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer from its observed EPSG:4326 CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially join each reprojected hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and attach the tract identifier.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join using the hospital points as the target features and the census tracts as the join features. For each hospital, retain its attributes and attach the containing tract identifier from the tract layer, using the observed GEOID field. Preserve one hospital record per input hospital.

requirements.scope: The hospital point layer and census tract polygon layer must use compatible CRSs before spatial joining.
